en.headline: Mark Six Halloween Snowball first prize rolls over to HK$108 million jackpot
en.dek: No one claimed the top prize in Saturday’s draw, so the estimated first-division fund for Thursday’s draw reaches HK$108 million.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club said no one won the first prize in the Mark Six Halloween Snowball draw held on Saturday evening.

The drawn numbers were 10, 11, 19, 27, 37 and 43, with the extra number 8. There were 9.5 winning units in the second prize, each paying HK$716,830, and 317 units in the third prize at HK$57,280 each.

The Club said the first-division prize fund is estimated to reach HK$108 million for a single HK$10 winning unit in the next draw, scheduled for Thursday 5 November at 9:30 pm. There will be no draw on Tuesday to allow more time for ticket purchases.
Total turnover for the Saturday draw was HK$187,748,219. Tickets for the next draw remain available through the Club’s usual channels.

zh.headline: 六合彩萬聖節金多寶頭獎無人中 周四頭獎基金料達 1.08億
zh.dek: 周六攪珠無人獨中頭獎，馬會估計周四攪珠頭獎基金可達 1.08億元。
body: 香港賽馬會表示，周六晚上舉行的六合彩萬聖節金多寶攪珠，無人中頭獎。
攪出號碼為 10、11、19、27、37及 43，特別號碼為 8。二獎有 9.5注中，每注獎金 71.683萬元；三獎有 317注中，每注獎金 5.728萬元。
馬會指，下次攪珠定於 11月 5日（星期四）晚上 9時 30分舉行，估計頭獎基金可達 1.08億元。為讓市民有更多時間購票，星期二不會攪珠。
周六攪珠總投注額為 1.87748219億元。下期獎券可透過馬會各渠道購買。
